messages.subject: Project Drake — completion funds flow and board pack
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam,

For the board this afternoon and completion on 15 December, the funds flow is: £19.9m cash consideration to Birchall Stone; £1.5m to the escrow account; £2.1m to repay net debt to Clydesford Bank; plus our fees and £112k stamp duty. Total funding requirement £23.79m, met from existing cash and a £5.79m RCF drawdown. CHAPS instructions to follow on the 15th.

The board minutes and the due diligence report are with Priya.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
